stories.title: Alberta voters reject plan for referendum to leave Canada
stories.summary: Albertans overwhelmingly rejected a proposal that would have begun a process toward independence, a result the Guardian calls a victory for Prime Minister Mark Carney and supporters of Canadian unity. The referendum campaign exposed deep divisions inside the province, including among separatists.

stories.title: Suspect arrested after Limoges town hall set alight during disorder
stories.summary: French media report an arrest after Limoges city hall was set on fire during weekend disorder, with the clock tower spire collapsing as flames engulfed the building. Investigators are working to establish who torched the historic town hall on Saturday.

stories.title: Why Israeli Gen Z voters are drawn to the far right
stories.summary: With more than half a million young Israelis due to vote next week, the BBC looks at why Gen Z voters are shifting toward far-right parties. That bloc could prove decisive in a closely contested election.

stories.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
stories.summary: Almost 300 people have been injured, more than half of them police, as anti-government demonstrations in Albania enter a seventh day. The unrest shows no sign of easing.

stories.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst growth fund
stories.summary: Otter.ai has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund, a structure that provides capital without diluting equity and earns returns from marketing results. The meeting-notes company says the money will fund expansion of its AI assistant.

stories.title: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
stories.summary: The Verge examines how CoreWeave’s heavy borrowing has turned one AI cloud provider’s balance sheet into a sector-wide worry. The piece lands as investors reassess the financing behind the AI infrastructure buildout.

stories.title: Some Google Home speakers caught downloading hundreds of gigs of data
stories.summary: Some Google Home speakers have been downloading hundreds of gigabytes of data, an apparent bug that can burn through a household’s bandwidth cap. The cause of the transfers is not yet clear.

stories.title: Blackwall quadruples valuation to $2.2B as sites fight bot traffic
stories.summary: Blackwall raised $100 million at a $2.2 billion valuation, four times its previous mark, to build security and filtering tools for websites. Demand is rising as publishers and retailers grapple with growing bot and AI traffic.

stories.title: Browns upcoming schedule before Thanksgiving, including bye week and trade deadline
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature lays out what comes next for Cleveland: a Week 7 trip to Tennessee, a bye week, then the NFL trade deadline. At 4-2 and leading the AFC North, the Browns face decisions about how aggressive to be on the market.

stories.title: Cleveland native Jason Kelce excited for Browns start: we’ve been waiting for this
stories.summary: Jason Kelce, a Cleveland native, used the word we on Monday Night Football while celebrating the Browns’ 4-2 start. The reaction captures how a first-place record in the AFC North has re-energized the fan base.

stories.title: Cleveland Browns news: the defense never rests in Browns Town
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature rounds up Cleveland news led by linebacker Carson Schwesinger’s play and coach Todd Monken’s read on an offense he says can be smoother. The 4-2 Browns have leaned on late-game execution to sit atop the AFC North.

stories.title: Browns depth plays important role in Week 6 win
stories.summary: The Browns’ official site breaks down how roster depth carried Cleveland in its Week 6 win over Baltimore, with backups stepping into larger roles. Depth has become a defining theme for a young team now leading the AFC North.

stories.title: Day alludes to Fahey’s bigger role with Sayin injured
stories.summary: Ryan Day indicated backup quarterback Luke Fahey will take on a larger role while Julian Sayin recovers from injury. Sayin is expected to miss at least several weeks, so Ohio State comes out of its bye with a new starter under center.

stories.title: Ohio State offers 2027 four-star Kentucky safety commit
stories.summary: Ohio State extended a scholarship offer to a four-star safety in the 2027 class who is currently committed to Kentucky. The move signals the staff is still chasing defensive back talent for next cycle.

stories.title: Skull Session: Ohio State-Indiana is more a feud than a rivalry
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors frames Ohio State-Indiana as more feud than rivalry, notes Ryan Day is 2-1 against Curt Cignetti, and credits the Buckeyes’ special teams. It is a bye-week reset after Ohio State’s 19-15 win in Bloomington.

stories.title: I felt sorry for Fred: Horner on Ferrari team boss rumours
stories.summary: Christian Horner said he felt sorry for Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur when speculation linking Horner to the Ferrari job surfaced last month. His comments address a rumour that swirled as Ferrari’s season came under scrutiny.

stories.title: Horner claims Lewis Hamilton wanted Red Bull move in secret meeting
stories.summary: Christian Horner claims Lewis Hamilton wanted to join Red Bull before he signed with Mercedes, describing a secret meeting between the two sides. The claim revives one of the sport’s enduring what-ifs ahead of the United States Grand Prix.

stories.title: When is the next F1 race? United States Grand Prix dates and schedule
stories.summary: Crash.net runs through the dates and session times for this weekend’s United States Grand Prix at Circuit of the Americas. Austin hosts the next round as the 2026 title fight resumes.

stories.title: Gary Anderson: the details that really separate Red Bull and Mercedes
stories.summary: Technical analyst Gary Anderson breaks down the design details dividing Red Bull and Mercedes as the title fight heads to Austin. His read lands with Mercedes closing in on the 2026 constructors’ championship.

stories.title: Tarkov update nerfs hugely overpowered Scourge boss on Labs
stories.summary: Battlestate Games deployed an update that nerfs Scourge, the new boss on The Lab, after players complained he was overpowered. The change lands as the Scourge Incursion event, live since October 16, winds down.

stories.title: Granville residents to consider large data center ban
stories.summary: Granville voters will decide on Election Day whether to amend the village charter to ban large data centers, defined by peak load thresholds. The measure reflects growing Central Ohio tension over data center growth.

stories.title: More than 54,000 Franklin County voters face polling location changes
stories.summary: More than 54,000 Franklin County voters will cast ballots at different polling places than in past elections. Officials are urging voters to confirm their assigned site before the Nov. 3 general election.

stories.title: Federal judge rejects Ohio Supreme Court justice’s lawsuit over party labels
stories.summary: A federal judge rejected Ohio Supreme Court Justice Jennifer Brunner’s challenge to a state law requiring party affiliations on general-election ballots for high court candidates. The ruling leaves the law in place for Nov. 3, when Brunner faces Republican Colleen O’Donnell in a race that could give Republicans full control of the court.

stories.title: Columbus police, fire overtime spending exceeds budget by millions
stories.summary: Columbus police and fire overtime spending is millions of dollars over budget, prompting City Council members to ask the city auditor for 10 years of overtime data. The request came at a Monday hearing as council scrutinizes public safety costs.
